description: A multi-row VALUES source widens its column types and nullability across every row, not just the first one

columns.name: column1
columns.note: row 1 is int32 (1), row 2 is decimal (2.5); widens to decimal instead of staying int32 from row 1 alone

columns.name: column3
columns.note: row 1 is 10 (int32), row 2 is NULL; row 1 alone would infer NOT NULL

name: values_multi_row_widening
query_sql:
-- @name GetValueRows
-- @returns :many
SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, 'a', 10), (2.5, 'b', NULL)) AS t
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE dummy (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY)
